title: Masoom Asghar Masoom Asghar
body:
MASOOM ASGHAR MASOOM ASGHAR
<<DIVIDER>>
Jungle Ki Qamoshi Hai Sisakti Hai hawayen
Kaisa Ye Sitam Hogaya Roti Hai Fizayen
Bikre Huwe Lashe kahin Jalte huwe Qiame
Ek Ghamzada Maa Deti Hai Bete Ko Sadayen
<<MINI>>
Masoom Asghar Masoom Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bano Ke Dilbar Masoom Asghar
Besheer Payse Aye Jhule Wale
Maa Ke Dulare Ajaa Humakkar
Gensu Sajaoun Jhula Jhulaoun
<<DIVIDER>>
Loori Sunaoun Aye jane Madar
Aye Mere Pyare Mere Dulare
Dil ke Sahare Shashmaha Asghar
Kaisi Ghadi Hai Kya Bebasi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa dundti Hai Har Simth Dilbar
Jungal Sisakta Harsu Andhera Aur Tu Hai Tanha Suni Zami Par
Kisko Sada Doo Kisko Pukarun
Aao Manalo Rootho Na Dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ankhon Ke Taare Sun Maa Ke Naale
Hojaoun Sadqe Beta Main Tujper
Bechain Mamta Karti Hai Girya
Lab Par Hai Nouha Aye Mere Dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jhula Kahin Hai Takya Kahin Hai
Jalti Zamin Par Neend Aaye Kyonkar
